description: Header file defining the AddressTrackerLinux class, which tracks network interface addresses on Linux using rtnetlink, for use by NetworkChangeNotifier. It includes constructors for tracking and non-tracking modes, methods for initialization, retrieving address maps, setting callbacks for address and link changes, and utility functions related to network interfaces.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux
classes.description: Manages tracking of network interface addresses and online links on Linux, with support for tracking mode (with callbacks and diffs) and non-tracking mode (snapshot). It interacts with rtnetlink and provides updates to NetworkChangeNotifier.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux::AddressTrackerAutoLock
classes.description: Helper class for managing lock acquisition and release in tracking mode.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Default constructor for non-tracking mode, takes a snapshot of current system configuration.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Constructor for tracking mode, sets callbacks and ignored interfaces, optionally with a blocking thread runner.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Starts watching system configuration for changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: InitWithFdForTesting
methods.description: Initializes with a provided file descriptor, used for testing.

methods.name: GetAddressMap
methods.description: Returns current address map; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetOnlineLinks
methods.description: Returns set of online interface indices; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetInitialDataAndStartRecordingDiffs
methods.description: Returns current address map and online links, and starts recording diffs; only in tracking mode.

methods.name: SetDiffCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to be called on address/link diffs in tracking mode.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns current network connection type; blocks until Init completes.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns interface name given index, acts like if_indextoname.

methods.name: IsTunnelInterface
methods.description: Checks if interface name refers to a tunnel.
